name: @swao/module-challenge
description: SWAO stakeholder-challenge module (Enterprise tier): the `challenge` command (LLM agents stress-test a WSP assessment from five stakeholder personas) plus its ChallengeScreen and the persona taxonomy (PERSONAS / AGENT_IDS / CANONICAL_AGENT_ORDER / reportViewToAgentId, consumed by the host report command). ADR-0048 modular architecture, Phase 5, #0580. The runtime gate is `requireTier('enterprise', { feature: 'challenge' })` (ADR-0049: tier-gating is runtime requireTier; the command stays visible). Enterprise is the preserved current gate (migrated from premium), not a new decision. The host injects its SWAO version (branding is host-only) into the screen and the createLlmProvider factory (a sibling-module function) into registerChallenge.
